name: Release vsix to OpenVSX and VSCode marketplace
on:
    release:
        types: [published]

jobs:
    release:
        name: "Release"
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v7
              with:
                  submodules: true

            - name: Set up Node.js
              uses: actions/setup-node@v7
              with:
                  node-version: 22.x

            - name: Set up AdvanceCOMP
              run: |
                  export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
                  apt-get update
                  apt-get -y install advancecomp

            - name: Install dependencies
              run: npm install

            - name: Run TypeScript compiler
              run: npx tsc

            - name: Build VSIX bundle
              uses: HaaLeo/publish-vscode-extension@1b8df468b849f76a143b8c18bf0ffa2075398d12 # == v2.1.0
              id: build-vsix
              with:
                  dryRun: true
                  pat: 'stub'

            - name: Recompress VSIX bundle
              run: advzip -z4 ${{ steps.build-vsix.outputs.vsixPath }}

            - name: Publish to Open VSX Registry
              uses: HaaLeo/publish-vscode-extension@1b8df468b849f76a143b8c18bf0ffa2075398d12
              with:
                  pat: ${{ secrets.OPEN_VSX_TOKEN }}
                  extensionFile: ${{ steps.build-vsix.outputs.vsixPath }}

            - name: Publish to Visual Studio Marketplace
              uses: HaaLeo/publish-vscode-extension@1b8df468b849f76a143b8c18bf0ffa2075398d12
              with:
                  pat: ${{ secrets.VS_MARKETPLACE_TOKEN }}
                  registryUrl: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com
                  extensionFile: ${{ steps.build-vsix.outputs.vsixPath }}

            - name: Upload VSIX file to release page on GitHub
              uses: djn24/add-asset-to-release@dc65328ec8f76d54e5e71d930011a1da182a8406 # == v2
              with:
                  token: ${{secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN}}
                  path: ${{ steps.build-vsix.outputs.vsixPath }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
